LanguageData.Rukaya_FlightDisabledFunctionalWings: Flight requires two functioning natural or bionic wings. Each wing must retain at least 50% function. Prosthetic wings cannot support flight.
LanguageData.Rukaya_EmergencyFly_FunctionalWings: {PAWN_labelShort} needs two functioning natural or bionic wings for emergency flight. Each wing must retain at least 50% function.
LanguageData.Rukaya_FlightModeCommandFunctionalWingsD: This Rukaya takes off while drafted until flight is switched off or she is undrafted. An enemy target triggers flight regardless of this switch.\n\nRequires two functioning natural or bionic wings, with at least 50% function on each side, and at least 10% satiety. Prosthetic wings cannot support flight.
